description: UFCalendar's matchmaker: the fights worth making in one promotion, scored for rank proximity, momentum, competitiveness and story (rematches, eliminators), per division or across the roster. Our own engine over rankings, Power Index and recent form — not a list of booked bouts. Runs without the website's style-clash (Fight DNA) factor, so scores can differ slightly from ufcalendar.com.

division.description: One division slug, e.g. "lightweight", "womens-strawweight". Omit for the cross-division board; meta.divisions lists the valid ones.

org.description: Promotion slug (MMA promotions; bkfc has no matchmaker pool).
